texts.li: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} compared which of their Pokémon had learned what at which level, and argued over one of them.
{A_nameDef} showed {B_nameDef} a trick for keeping a Pokémon calm before a fight, and {B_nameDef} came back with a better one.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} talked over what they'd catch next, if the colony ever has belts enough.
